properties.areaDesc: Kuskokwim Delta Coast and Nunivak Island; Interior Kuskokwim Delta
properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 25 at 3:55AM AKDT until October 26 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 55 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Kuskokwim Delta.

* WHEN...From 4 PM this afternoon to 10 AM AKDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects and a few
power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Southwest winds will build steadily Sunday
morning, becoming strong and gusty by Sunday afternoon. Winds are
expected to be strongest along the coast, but gusts as high as 55
mph are expected to persist inland up to Bethel. Strongest winds
are expected late Sunday night, and winds will begin to diminish
through Monday morning. However, steady southwesterly flow is
expected to continue into midweek.
properties.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

NWSheadline: WIND ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM 4 PM THIS AFTERNOON TO 10 AM AKDT MONDAY

properties.areaDesc: Mobile Coastal; Baldwin Coastal; Escambia Coastal; Santa Rosa Coastal; Okaloosa Coastal
properties.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 25 at 6:54AM CDT until October 26 at 6:00PM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...In Alabama, Mobile Coastal and Baldwin Coastal
Counties. In Florida, Escambia Coastal, Santa Rosa Coastal and
Okaloosa Coastal Counties.

* WHEN...Through Monday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
properties.instruction:
Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

NWSheadline: HIGH RIP CURRENT RISK REMAINS IN EFFECT THROUGH MONDAY AFTERNOON

properties.areaDesc: Kuskokwim Delta Coast and Nunivak Island
properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 25 at 3:52AM AKDT until October 26 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...Coastal flooding, with water levels of 2.0 to 3.0 feet
above the normal highest tide line, and 40 mph southwest winds
with gusts up to 55 mph.

* WHERE...Kuskokwim Delta Coast, including Kipnuk, Kwigillingok
and Kongiganak.

* WHEN...7 PM Sunday to 7 AM AKDT Monday, highest water levels
expected around midnight Monday morning.

* IMPACTS...Coastal flooding of low lying areas and erosion are
possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Kipnuk is expected to see water levels 2.0
to 3.0 ft above the normal high tide line. Kwigillingok and
Kongiganak are expected to have water levels of 1.0 to 2.0 ft
above the normal highest tide line. Following this system,
steady southwesterly flow is expected to continue for the
Kuskokwim Delta coastline through Tuesday, which may slow the
ability for flood waters to recede.
properties.instruction:
A coastal flood advisory indicates that onshore winds and tides
will combine to generate flooding of low areas along the shore.

NWSheadline: COASTAL FLOOD ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM 7 PM THIS EVENING TO 7 AM AKDT MONDAY
